integrity: Exact symbolic identities and local-series certificates are bundled and replayed. General rational implicitization and the degree-eight framework are credited to prior work rather than claimed as new.
scientific_limitations: The complete singularity profile is proved for one explicit complex projective octic. The claim does not classify the full constant-width family, and literature originality remains subject to the possibility of unindexed equivalent computations.
title: The singularity profile of the minimal-degree constant-width octic
